error[L0100]: `lenof` measures what a name begins, and a text literal has no name

  |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  = note: [0370]: `lenof` takes a binding, a field or element path, a slice of one or a call's result; bind the text first, as in `word := "abcde"`, then write `lenof word`
